thread:
Maria: Heads-up: rolling RBAC tweak for private deploys tonight; trying to figure audit impact. TL;DR: svcacct role narrowed, but audit logs show no 'roleBinding' events in airgapped tenants. Anyone seen this?
Alex: :eyes: saw similar in staging two weeks ago. kube-audit config was missing `requestObject: true` for the admin-level webhook.
Jamal: We also have kms-agent in env var mode (not mTLS) on those tenants — could be suppressing detailed logs. Check /var/log/kms-agent.log and `kubectl logs -n redwood-priv kms-agent-0`.
Maria: Good call. I found only high-level entries. Example snippet: ```kube-audit: user="system:serviceaccount:..." verb="update" resource="rolebinding"``` but no old/new diff. Need full object.
Kate: If `requestObject=false` the webhook only gets attrs. Set to true and redeploy webhook CA. That will add payloads, but it's noisy. We need targeted filters: include role/rolebinding only for namespaces matching `tenant-*`.
Ben: Question: changing that will increase S3 log storage costs for customers. Is retention policy per-tenant configurable? Ops wants an opt-in.
Alex: We can pipeline filter in fluentd to only store when `resource` in [role, rolebinding, secret] OR when `request.user` in admin group. That reduces size by ~70% in staging.
Jamal: :rotating_light: Related vuln triage: `keystore-agent` CVE-2026-0421 landed in scanner for onprem builds. It affects HSM handshake fallback. Timeline?
Maria: Reported yesterday by PS for Customer X. We need mitigation steps before full patch. Can we disable fallback to software keystore in config? I think so: `KESTORE_FALLBACK=false`.
Kate: Yes config toggle exists. But toggling may break older nodes. Suggest canary in tenant-staging then canary-prod.
Ben: For incident response, we should: 1) enable verbose audit for RBAC changes, 2) disable fallback, 3) rotate affected service account keys, 4) notify impacted customers. Agree?
Alex: Add step 5: snapshot current keystore state and logs for forensic analysis. Use `s3://priv-keystore-snapshots/<tenant>/$(date +%s)` with encrypted upload.
Jamal: Also ensure KMS integration logs include the KMS operation ID. We saw earlier it's not propagated through the agent. PR open to add `kms_operation_id` field on 1771.
Maria: I'll open an IR runbook entry. Minimal checklist: commands for forced rotation, audit filters, kms-agent config path, rollback steps.
Maria: Draft runbook snippet:
```bash
# disable fallback
kubectl -n redwood-priv set env daemonset/kms-agent KESTORE_FALLBACK=false
# increase audit verbosity
kubectl apply -f priv-audit-policy.yaml
# rotate keys
./scripts/rotate-tenant-keys.sh tenant-123
```
Kate: :thumbsup: Please include exact log file paths and retention impacts. Ops, can you estimate cost delta for enabling `requestObject=true` for all private tenants?
Ben: Quick estimate: ~2.4x storage on audit logs for those namespaces; with fluentd filter we get ~1.15x. I'll post numbers in a follow-up.
Alex: I'll push the PR to add `kms_operation_id` and bump agent version. Targeting patch release tomorrow. Can someone own staging canary?
Maria: I'll take staging canary. Jamal you'll do forensic snapshot with me?
Jamal: On it. Starting snapshot now. Leaving logs attached when done.
security-bot: Incident milestone created: PRIV-IR-2026-07; severity: medium; owner: maria; playbooks: keystore-fallback-disable, rbac-audit-boost.
Maria: Thanks. Posting progress in #incidents once staging passes. Will schedule customer notification template.
